findings.title: Observer materializes whole stream and retains all native UUIDs
findings.cause: close() hashes self.path.read_bytes(), allocating the entire completed prefix gzip in RAM. native_event_ids (23,68) also retains every native UUID for the full calendar. Thus the claimed bounded stream becomes proportional to full output/events and can add a late resource failure after spending a native slot.
findings.required_fix: Hash the output incrementally and replace whole-run UUID RAM retention with an explicitly bounded/count-only or disk-backed exact mechanism; preserve every emitted frame and honest UUID count semantics.

findings.title: Prior P0 financial gate does not bind current P1 consumed data/common economic call
findings.cause: verify_prior_financial validates the prior P0 row and report against its root receipt, but never compares its native_input_sha256 with current g.native_input_sha256. Nor does it bind a common economic kwargs/config projection between prior P0 and current P1. A fully valid P0 qualification can therefore satisfy this gate while P1 uses a different pinned set of nine consumer files or otherwise noncomparable call metadata. The historical source_config_data_comparable PASS of P0 does not establish comparability to the current not-yet-run P1.
findings.required_fix: Bind and compare exact current/prior consumed input identity plus a canonical common economic identity permitting only the declared TP flag and artifact/namespace metadata differences. Include source/calendar/seed/fees/clocks/venue assumptions and exact decoded control kwargs; fail closed on mismatch.

findings.title: Prior completion/supervisor checks do not cross-bind report and physical identities
findings.cause: Completion manifest and supervisor are pinned and checked for UUID/source/OS0, but their report path/SHA and physical freeze/config/input/recipe bindings are not compared to the qualified P0 report/receipt/completed row. The manifest artifact roles and extra-evidence hashes are not revalidated here. A same-UUID but conflicting proposal/export manifest can pass alongside a separately qualified report; the required all-rows/hash physical chain is incomplete.
findings.required_fix: Cross-bind manifest/supervisor report path/SHA, worker PID/observed exit, physical identity/freeze/config/input/recipe and completed row to the root receipt and actual report; rehash the manifest-bound actual role outputs needed by qualification. Preserve P0 native3TP exemption and actual root OS authority.
